manual.item_batcher.line2: {0}The Item Batcher is designed to collect a set of items from an inputting conveyor before sending them onwards, in order to transfer optimized batch sizes to machinery.{1}
manual.item_batcher.line3: In §2batched mode§r, incoming items will be accepted into the inventory directly below the filters, and the collected batch will only be output when all filters are satisfied.{0}
manual.item_batcher.line4: Once the output mode of the device has been adjusted to §2single mode§r, any item that satisfies its filtered quantity will be output instead.{0}
manual.item_batcher.line5: The connections below the filters of the buffer set the target color of {0}redstone wire{1} through attached {2}Redstone Interface Connectors{3}.{4}
manual.item_batcher.line6: When each individual filter is satisfied, a high signal on its configured color will be sent out through the connector.{0}
manual.item_batcher.line7: Note that if multiple filters use the same colour, all must be satisfied for a signal to output.{0}
manual.item_batcher.line8: These signals can be used to configure machinery, displays, or other contraptions to control entire factories.
